_notes: How UQM 0.8.0's own comm.c lays out a talk's text, with its own font loading and TextRect (tools/extract/golden/commtext.c), for each race in data/conversations.json with its font, text width, baseline, alignments and colours from its description, from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef).

lines: some of the race's conversation entries (phrase: the entry's number from 1), each paged by SplitSubPages (pages: the page's text's SHA-256, first 16 hex digits, and its time in milliseconds) and each page drawn as a subtitle by add_text (1, ...): drawn, a list a page.

replies: sets of entries as the player's replies (RefreshResponses in the player's font, font.player), the first shown and the lit one; summary: the race's first 30 entries as the subtitles of DoConvSummary (the tiny font, font.tiny), each page's drawing.

Drawing calls as commtext.c says: a line names its text by its place (the page; the reply in the set; the subtitle in the summary's list) and its byte offset; the bullet and MORE are themselves, in hex.
